title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (September, 2026)
summary: The September 2026 cumulative update for Dynamics 365 Business Central announces BC28 CU05 with sandbox and production environment management in the Admin Center, BC29 in public preview, and includes version lifecycle dates and support information for all active and end-of-life versions from BC14 through BC29.
key_points: BC28 CU05 released with platform 28.0.54016.0 and application 28.5.54151.54178 for both cloud and on-premises
BC29 (2026 release wave 2) is now available in public preview
Admin Center now supports managing production and sandbox environments
Multiple versions released: BC27 CU11, BC26 CU17, with older versions BC24-BC14 at end of life
Version lifecycle table shows support dates, with BC28 supported until October 13, 2027

quotes.text: Cloud (SaaS): Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key new capability for administrators to control their environments through the Admin Center for cloud deployments

quotes.text: The public preview for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) is available
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the availability of the next major version for partners and customers to test new features early

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the support timeline and policy framework for on-premises deployments using the Modern Lifecycle Policy
